seo.title: Factors of 30 Speed Grid - Number Theory & Divisors Game
seo.metaDescription: Find all 8 factors of 30 on a 100-tile math grid. Practice divisibility rules for 2, 3, and 5 in this fast-paced classroom math clicker.
seo.intro: Thirty is the product of three distinct prime numbers: 2 x 3 x 5. Because it combines three distinct prime building blocks, it has 8 factors: 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 10, 15, and 30. Searching for these factors across the 100-number grid teaches students to integrate multiple divisibility rules at once.
seo.howToPlay: Scan the grid to click all 8 factors of 30. Correct clicks highlight green with a checkmark. Non-factors flash red and cost 2 seconds of timer penalty. Locate all 8 factors to finish.
seo.teacherNotes: Highlight that 30 is divisible by 2, 3, and 5. This makes it an ideal case study for prime factorization trees (30 = 2 x 3 x 5).
